test_atari_train: test the atari.train function with basic parameters for SpIN training on Atari video data
test_atari_train_pfor: test the atari.train function with per_example and pfor options enabled for covariance jacobian computation
run_atari_train_cli: run the atari example CLI module with absl flags for SpIN training on montezuma_revenge
build_atari_train: build a SpIN training pipeline for Atari games with configurable iterations, batch size, learning rate, and eigenvalue count
review_atari_train: review the atari.train function that sets up and starts training for SpIN on Atari video data
